# CalcDigi

> Free online calculation tools, interactive visual graphs, step-by-step mathematical formulas, and instant calculation engines across Finance, Health, Math, Housing, Business, Science, and more.

## Knowledge Graph & Machine Feeds
- [Full Knowledge Base (LLMs-Full)](https://calcdigi.com/llms-full.txt): Complete directory of all 340+ calculators with exact mathematical formulas, input requirements, and verified FAQs.
- [Machine-Readable Tools Index (JSON)](https://calcdigi.com/tools.json): Direct structured API feed of all tools.
- [XML Sitemap](https://calcdigi.com/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML index of all pages.
- [All Calculators Directory](https://calcdigi.com/pages/calculators): Searchable directory of all calculators.

## Core Computation Methodology & Technical Standards
- Precision: Client-side IEEE 754 floating-point calculations with big-integer and arbitrary precision fallback for factorials, combinatorics, and high-order matrices.
- Privacy & Security: 100% in-browser execution with zero telemetry, zero storage of personal financial/health numbers.
- Financial Standards: US Rule 78, Actuarial/APR Method, IRS standard mileage & tax tables (2026), compound frequency compounding schedules.
- Health Standards: World Health Organization (WHO) and CDC BMI & BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor / Katch-McArdle) standards.
- Engineering Standards: ISO 80000, SI derived metric standards, NIST physical constants.

### Finance, Loans & Taxation (40 Calculators)
Hub URL: https://calcdigi.com/pages/finance
- [401(k) Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/401k-calculator): Estimate your 401(k) balance at retirement from your contribution rate, employer match, raises and investment returns — using the 2026 IRS c...
- [Alimony Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/alimony-calculator): Get a rough estimate of spousal support and its likely duration from both spouses' incomes and the length of the marriage. — Formula: `Annual support = 30% of payer&rsquo;s gross income − 20% of payee&rsquo;s gross income`
- [APR Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/apr-calculator): Find the true annual cost of a loan once upfront fees are included, so you can compare offers with different rates and fees side by side. — Formula: `Loan − Fees = Σ Payment ÷ (1 + APR/12)^k, for k = 1 … n`
- [APY Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/apy-calculator): Convert a nominal interest rate into annual percentage yield (APY) and see how compounding frequency changes what you actually earn. — Formula: `APY = (1 + r ÷ n)^n − 1`
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/auto-loan-calculator): Estimate your monthly car payment including sales tax, dealer fees, your down payment and trade-in, and see how much interest the loan costs... — Formula: `Amount financed = Price + Sales tax + Fees + Trade-in payoff − Down payment − Trade-in value`
- [Break-Even Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/break-even-calculator): Work out how many units you need to sell — and how much revenue you need — before your business starts making a profit. — Formula: `Break-even units = Fixed costs ÷ (Price − Variable cost per unit)`
- [Budget Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/budget-calculator): Split your monthly take-home pay into needs, wants and savings with a simple budget rule — and see how your current spending compares.
- [Business Profit Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/business-profit-calculator): Turn revenue and costs into gross profit, EBITDA, operating profit and net profit — with the margin at each level.
- [CD Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/cd-calculator): Find out how much interest a certificate of deposit will earn and what it will be worth when it matures. — Formula: `Maturity value = Deposit × (1 + APY)^(months ÷ 12)`
- [Child Support Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/child-support-calculator): Estimate monthly child support using the income-shares approach that most US states follow.
- [College Savings Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/college-savings-calculator): Estimate what college will cost by the time your child enrolls and how much you need to save each month to pay for it.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/compound-interest-calculator): See how your savings grow when interest earns interest. Add a starting balance, regular monthly deposits and a rate to project your balance ... — Formula: `A = P(1 + r/n)^(n·t)`
- [Credit Card Payoff Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/credit-card-payoff-calculator): Find out how long it will take to clear your credit card balance and how much interest you'll pay — or what you need to pay each month to be...
- [Crypto Profit Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/crypto-profit-calculator): Work out the profit or loss on a cryptocurrency trade after exchange fees and taxes, and the price you need to sell at to break even. — Formula: `Coins = (Investment − Buy fee) ÷ Buy price`
- [Currency Converter](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/currency-converter): Convert between more than 160 world currencies using reference exchange rates that are refreshed every day. — Formula: `Amount in B = Amount in A × (rate of B ÷ rate of A)`
- [Debt Payoff Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/debt-payoff-calculator): See when you'll be debt-free at your current payment, and how much sooner an extra monthly payment gets you there.
- [Dividend Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/dividend-calculator): Project your dividend income and portfolio value over time, with or without reinvesting dividends. — Formula: `Dividend yield = Annual dividends per share ÷ Share price`
- [Down Payment Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/down-payment-calculator): See how much cash you need to buy a home — down payment plus closing costs — and how long it will take to save it.
- [Emergency Fund Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/emergency-fund-calculator): Work out how big your emergency fund should be, how far along you are, and when you'll reach your target.
- [Freelancer Tax Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/freelancer-tax-calculator): Estimate the taxes on your freelance or 1099 income — self-employment tax plus federal and state income tax — and how much to pay each quart... — Formula: `SE tax = Net profit × 92.35% × 15.3%`
- [Home Affordability Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/home-affordability-calculator): Find the most expensive home you can likely qualify for, based on your income, existing debts, down payment and today's mortgage rates. — Formula: `Front-end DTI = Housing payment ÷ Gross monthly income`
- [Hourly to Salary Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/hourly-to-salary-calculator): Turn an hourly wage into a yearly salary — including overtime — or work out the hourly rate behind a salary offer. — Formula: `Annual salary = Hourly wage × Hours per week × Weeks per year`
- [Inflation Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/inflation-calculator): See how much a dollar amount from any year since 1913 is worth today using official US Consumer Price Index data — or project future prices ... — Formula: `Value in year B = Amount × CPI(B) ÷ CPI(A)`
- [Investment Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/investment-calculator): Project how your investments could grow from a starting amount and regular monthly contributions, and see the result in today's dollars. — Formula: `Monthly rate = (1 + annual return)^(1/12) − 1`
- [Loan Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/loan-calculator): Work out the monthly payment and total interest on any fixed-rate loan, then see the full year-by-year amortization schedule. — Formula: `M = P × r ÷ [1 − (1 + r)^−n]`
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/mortgage-calculator): 
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/net-worth-calculator): Add up what you own and what you owe to find your net worth, and see how it compares with other US households your age. — Formula: `Net worth = Total assets − Total liabilities`
- [PayPal Fee Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/paypal-fee-calculator): Find out how much PayPal takes from a payment and what you'll receive — or how much to invoice so you end up with an exact amount. — Formula: `Charge = (Amount you want + fixed fee) ÷ (1 − percentage fee)`
- [Rent vs. Buy Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/rent-vs-buy-calculator): Compare where you'd end up financially if you bought a home versus renting and investing the money you'd otherwise put into it.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/retirement-calculator): See what your savings could grow to by retirement, how big a nest egg your target income needs, and how long your money will last. — Formula: `Needed = W × [1 − ((1 + g) ÷ (1 + r))^n] ÷ (r − g)`
- [ROI Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/roi-calculator): Measure the return on any investment — a stock, a property, a marketing campaign or a business project — as a total and as a yearly rate. — Formula: `ROI = (Amount returned − Amount invested) ÷ Amount invested × 100%`
- [Roth IRA Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/roth-ira-calculator): Project how much your Roth IRA could hold at retirement — all of it tax-free — and how much more that is than saving the same money in a tax...
- [Salary Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/salary-calculator): Convert any pay amount into hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly, monthly, quarterly and annual figures.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/sales-tax-calculator): Add sales tax to a price, or back it out of a receipt total, using any US state's rate plus your local tax. — Formula: `Total = Price × (1 + rate)`
- [Savings Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/savings-calculator): Find out how much you need to set aside each month to reach a savings goal — or how much your regular deposits will grow to with interest. — Formula: `Monthly deposit = (Goal − Current × (1 + i)^n) × i ÷ [(1 + i)^n − 1]`
- [Social Security Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/social-security-calculator): See how your Social Security retirement benefit changes depending on when you claim, from age 62 to 70.
- [Stock Return Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/stock-return-calculator): Calculate the total and annualized return on a stock you bought, including dividends, trading costs and taxes. — Formula: `Total return = (Sale value − Cost − Fees + Dividends − Tax) ÷ Cost`
- [Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/take-home-pay-calculator): Estimate how much of your salary actually lands in your bank account each payday after taxes, retirement contributions and benefits.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/tax-calculator): 
- [VAT Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/finance/vat-calculator): Add VAT to a net price or extract the VAT from a gross price, using common country rates or your own. — Formula: `Gross = Net × (1 + VAT rate)`

### Health, Fitness & Nutrition (35 Calculators)
Hub URL: https://calcdigi.com/pages/health
- [Alcohol Unit Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/health/alcohol-unit-calculator): Determine your Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) and trace metabolic elimination time using the clinical Widmark equation. Understand standa... — Formula: `BAC = [ (Alcohol in Grams × 5.14) ÷ (Body Weight in lbs × r) ] − (β × Elapsed Hours)`
- [Baby Weight Percentile Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/health/baby-weight-calculator): Assess your infant's physical development against the World Health Organization (WHO) Child Growth Standards (0 to 24 months). Calculate exa... — Formula: `{"Z = \\frac{(W / M)^L - 1}{L \\cdot S} \\quad (L \\neq 0)"}`
- [Blood Pressure Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/health/blood-pressure-calculator): Interpret your blood pressure numbers using the landmark 2017 ACC/AHA Clinical Practice Guidelines. Evaluate Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) fo... — Formula: `MAP = Diastolic + 1/3 (Systolic - Diastolic)`
- [BMI Calculator](https://calcdigi.com/calculators/health/bmi-calculator): Calculate your Body Mass Index in US or metric units and see where you fall on the WHO scale, plus the healthy weight range for your height. — Formula: `BMI = weight (kg) ÷ [height (m)]²`
